Name: CP - HD Portrait - 3D Anime - Riley (Custom NPC)
Author: Gizzlembos03
Description:
This is my take on Riley. I tried to stay as loyal at the original as possible. Riley uses 8 outfits + beach, depending on season and day of the week. I copied the same conditions as the original so all should match.

With feedback from Riley's author (EssGee).

Uses Content patcher and HD Portraits.

-- Install --

1. You need this mods and all its requirements

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5811]Custom NPC - Riley[/url]

2. Download the mod and put the folder inside the zip in the mods folder. No need to replace anything.

All credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83595503]EssGee[/url]﻿ for creating Riley!

Downloads.Description: Updated model with feedback from author.
